sections.content:
Thank you for choosing DPS Gomtinagar Jnr. !

Prospectus can be acquired from the School counter. Application forms are to be filled in and submitted to the Administrative office. Admission to PG will be through Observation/Interaction. Dates for observation/interaction will be intimated in advance. There will be a written evaluation for the students seeking admission to Class Nursery till Class XI. Only those candidates, who clear, will be called for interaction/interview. During interaction/interview, only the child presence is required

The program we offer :

  • PG - (Age 3 plus)
  • Nursery - (Age 4 plus)
  • Prep - (Age 5 plus)
  • Class I - (Age 6 plus)
  • Class II to XII

Step 1: Entry Requirement

  • Prospectus can be acquired from the School Office.
  • Application forms are to be filled in and submitted to the Administrative office..
  • Playgroup Admission: Through Observation/Interaction.
  • Classes Nursery to III: Written Evaluation + Interaction. Only the child needs to be present for the interaction.

items.title:
Step 3: Pay Registration & Application Fee

  • You are requested to pay the Registration fee (Rs 1000/-only).
  • An entrance exam and an interaction will be scheduled
  • Upon selection, admission fee is required to be submitted.

Online Registration

Step 4: Admission Process - Documents Required

  • Birth Certificate (From Nagar Nigam)
  • 3 recent passport-size photographs of the child
  • Copy of Aadhar card (parents and child)
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable), PEN from previous school
  • Transfer Certificate or School Leaving Certificate
  • Report card of previous school
  • Medical records (if any)

Step 5: Pay Quarterly Fee

Pay the quarterly fees to complete the admission process latest by 15th of the beginning of the quarterly cycle.

Click here for Fee details

Step 6: Post Admission Process

Once admitted to the school, you’ll receive:

  • Admission Fee Receipt
  • Fee Booklet
  • ERP Login Credentials
  • Bus Route Details (if applicable)
  • Information for Uniform & Book Collection
  • Class & Section Allocation
  • Inclusion in Official Class Groups
